_comment: Paths for the collector. The database MUST NOT live under C:\ -- a Windows
reset wipes C:\, and surviving that is the entire point of this project.
live/data-usage.db   the working database. If you sync this folder to
cloud storage, note the live file is not a reliable
restore source: in WAL mode it is three files that a
sync client can upload mid-write.
data-usage.db        the backup, written with SQLite's backup() API after
a WAL checkpoint. Always a complete, self-contained,
internally consistent single file. THIS is the one to
restore from after a reset.
scratchDir holds a ~99 MB snapshot plus ~55 MB of CSVs mid-run. Keep it
OUTSIDE any synced folder, or every run uploads your raw usage history.
The collector refuses to clear a scratchDir that is a drive root, contains
the database, or holds files it did not put there.
srumECmdDir is where SrumECmd.exe lives (https://ericzimmerman.github.io/).
deviceLabel is what this machine is called in the dashboard, and it also
names its URL (/windows/<slug>) and its logo folder
(public/apps_logo/<slug>/).
splitApp names one app, as the dashboard shows it ("qBittorrent", "Steam"),
to set against everything else on the Overview -- for a machine where one
app dwarfs the rest. null means no split card.
